kv17.11:1.3: Nanu atthi keci paṭiggāhakā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalīkaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti?
kv17.11:1.5: Hañci atthi keci paṭiggāhakā āhuṇeyyā pāhuṇeyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalīkaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa, no vata re vattabbe
kv17.11:1.6: "Dāyakato va dānaṃ visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato ti." 2.
kv17.11:2.1: Dāyakato va dānaṃ visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato ti?
kv17.11:2.3: Nanu cattāro purisayugā aṭṭha purisapuggalā dakkhiṇeyyā vuttā Bhagavatā ti?
kv17.11:2.5: Hañci cattāro purisayugā aṭṭha purisapuggalā dakkhiṇeyyā vuttā Bhagavatā, no vata re vattabbe
kv17.11:2.6: "Dāyakato va dānaṃ visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato ti." 3.
kv17.11:3.1: Dāyakato va dānaṃ visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato ti?
kv17.11:3.3: Nanu atthi keci sotāpanne dānaṃ datvā dakkhiṇaṃ ārādhentīti?
kv17.11:3.5: Hañci atthi keci sotāpanne dānaṃ datvā dakkhiṇaṃ ārādhenti, no vata re vattabbe
kv17.11:3.6: "Dāyakato va dānaṃ visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato ti."
kv17.11:4.5: Hañci atthi keci Arahato dānaṃ datvā dakkhiṇaṃ ārādhenti, no vata re vattabbe
kv17.11:4.6: "Dāyakato va dānaṃ visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato ti." 4.
kv17.11:5.3: Añño aññassa kārako, parakataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ, añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvedetīti?
kv17.11:6.1: Dāyakato va dānaṃ visujjhati, na paṭiggāhakato ti?
kv17.11:6.6: Atth' Ānanda dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato,
kv17.11:6.7: atth' Ānanda dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati no dāyakato,
kv17.11:6.8: atth' Ānanda dakkhiṇā dāyakato c' eva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca,
kv17.11:6.9: atth' Ānanda dakkhiṇā n' eva dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
kv17.11:6.10: Imā kho Ānanda catasso dakkhiṇā visuddhiyo ti."
kv17.11:6.14: "Dāyakato va dānaṃ visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato ti."
